title: Maxwell House 27.5oz Ground Coffee Medium Original Roast
description: The Maxwell House 27.5oz Ground Coffee in Medium Original Roast has received a mix of positive and negative reviews from customers. Some customers expressed satisfaction with the taste and quality of the coffee, noting that it has been a long-time favorite for themselves and their family members. However, others were disappointed with the recent quality, mentioning issues such as bad vacuum seals on multiple cans leading to stale coffee. One customer even described the latest shipment as "truly horrible" and "undrinkable." Overall, the Maxwell House Ground Coffee seems to have a loyal following for its affordable price and decent taste. However, recent quality control issues have left some customers dissatisfied. If you are looking for a budget-friendly coffee option with a medium roast, this product might be worth Considering, but be cautious of potential quality issues. **
